question: For how many days did the Government of India launch the ‘Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan’ (GKRA), in June 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **125 days.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan (GKRA)** was launched by the **Hon’ble Prime Minister on ****20th June 2020**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• It was **operational for ****125 days**.
 
• The **GKRA aimed** to address the issues faced by returnee migrant workers and similarly affected rural populations due to the Covid-19 pandemic.
 
• Its **multi-pronged strategy** provided **immediate employment, livelihood opportunities, and infrastructure development in rural areas.**
 
• **Key Components**
 
 
• ​Immediate Employment and Livelihood Opportunities
 
• Public Infrastructure Development
 
• Focus on 25 Works in 116 Selected Districts
 
• Resource Envelope of Rs 50,000 Crore
 
• Monitoring and Implementation
 
 
 
• The Abhiyan achieved its **goals by providing employment, creating infrastructure, and enhancing livelihood opportunities.**
